text: {"overall_winner": "A", "qualities": [{"evidence": "multi-paragraph essay structure with an introduction, body paragraphs, personal experience, and conclusion", "quality": "Structural Organization", "description": "Measures the ability to organize writing into logical paragraphs with clear introductory and concluding statements."}, {"evidence": "phrases like 'In addition, when I came to the united states...', 'That being said...', and 'Overall, being self confident...'", "quality": "Cohesive Device Usage", "description": "Captures the effective use of transitional words and phrases to connect ideas across sentences and paragraphs."}, {"evidence": "complete sentences such as 'I believe that self-esteem comes from achievement because the more a student work hard, the more achievements he/she get...'", "quality": "Syntactic Complexity", "description": "Reflects the capacity to construct complex, fully formed sentences with dependent and independent clauses."}, {"evidence": "vocabulary related to the prompt like 'self-esteem', 'punctual', 'encourages', 'curious', and 'achievements'", "quality": "Topic-Specific Vocabulary", "description": "Demonstrates the range and accuracy of topic-relevant vocabulary used to articulate abstract ideas."}, {"evidence": "sustained personal narrative in paragraphs 12 through 15 detailing the author's experience learning English", "quality": "Elaboration and Evidence", "description": "Measures the ability to support general claims with specific personal examples and detailed explanations."}]}
